question: On what date did the 2027-28 FAFSA form become available to the general public?
answer: The 2027–28 FAFSA form became available to the public on about September 23, 2026, though the sources never state that date outright. The Department's press release, dated September 23, 2026, says the form "is online and available to the public" and calls it the earliest launch in program history [2]. The Financial Aid Toolkit announcement, also dated September 23, 2026, says the form "is now available" [3]. A September 24 Department blog post says the form was made available "this week" [6]. The earlier-than-required timing is consistent with the legal requirement that the form launch by October 1 [2]. The sources don't show whether any of this was a staggered rollout.

keyPoints.text: The Department of Education announced on 2026-09-23 that the 2027-28 FAFSA form was online and available to the public.
The 2027-28 FAFSA form was made available to students and families nationwide, with a blog post dated 2026-09-24 describing the launch as already having occurred.
The public release was scheduled to occur by Oct. 1, 2026, the statutory launch deadline under the FAFSA Deadline Act.
Beta testing of the 2027-28 form ran from August 2026 into early September before the public launch.

mayBeStale.text: Source 4 (dated 2026-07-21, updated 2026-09-23) describes the public release as a future event due by Oct. 1, which predates the actual launch announced in sources 2, 3 and 6.
Source 1 and source 5 are form PDFs dated 2026-10-01 that only give deadlines and do not state the launch date.
